content.value_statement: CloudBase apps often fail because auth, database, RLS, and storage rules are easy to misapply. This skill applies CloudBase-specific review checks before users ship or submit code.
actual_capabilities: Checks CloudBase auth guard patterns against documented rules.
Reviews Web, MiniProgram, CloudRun, and cloud-function implementations.
Flags PostgreSQL table creation and RLS policy gaps.
Reviews CloudBase Storage setup, domain requirements, and upload API usage.
Provides optional regex lint guidance from the included lint rules.
Guides semantic review through the rule index and rule files.
limitations: It does not ship an executable lint file.
Optional linting requires user approval before creating a temporary script.
Live CloudBase console configuration still needs direct verification.
Rules focus on CloudBase patterns, not general code quality.

use_cases.title: Review A Web App
use_cases.description: Check a CloudBase Web app for auth guards, SDK misuse, storage setup, and database access mistakes.

use_cases.title: Validate Database Changes
use_cases.description: Review PostgreSQL or NoSQL changes for table setup, permissions, RLS policies, and ownership fields.

use_cases.title: Prepare Submission
use_cases.description: Run a final CloudBase-focused review before a grader, demo, or production release.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my CloudBase project for common mistakes. Focus on the modules present in the code and explain the most important fixes first.

prompt_templates.title: Check Auth Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the authentication flow in this CloudBase app. Verify route guards, session checks, provider setup, and anonymous user handling.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Database And Storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit PostgreSQL and storage behavior for this CloudBase app. Check table creation, RLS policies, upload setup, and stored file references.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Release Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full CloudBase code review before release. Use the rule index, optional lint guidance with my approval, and semantic review for cross-module issues.

output_examples.input: Review a new CloudBase Web login flow before release.
output: Findings are grouped by auth, database, storage, and rule coverage.
Each issue explains the affected file, the CloudBase rule, and a direct fix.

output_examples.input: Check whether my CloudBase PostgreSQL app is ready for upload features.
output: The review covers table creation, RLS policies, storage domain setup, and upload result handling.
The response separates blocking errors from warnings and follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a CloudBase project for final grading.
output: The final review lists the highest-risk issues first.
It also identifies rules that need manual verification in the CloudBase environment.

best_practices: Run the review after implementation and before final submission.
Tell the assistant which CloudBase modules and frontend type your project uses.
Approve the optional lint script only after reviewing the code block.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a general security scanner for unrelated stacks.
Do not skip full rule files after only reading search results.
Do not treat lint output as complete when semantic review is required.

faq.question: Does this skill run code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents optional lint guidance, but the user must approve creating and running the temporary script.

faq.question: Can it review any project?
faq.answer: It is designed for CloudBase projects. It is less useful for unrelated stacks.

faq.question: Does it replace CloudBase console checks?
faq.answer: No. It can identify likely configuration gaps, but live environment state still needs direct verification.

faq.question: Which areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on auth, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, storage, data model, and CloudBase-specific SDK usage.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the project code, target frontend, CloudBase modules used, and any known runtime errors.
